bio.text: David Fabrikant is a write-in candidate with no party affiliation for Florida's 21st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He graduated from Hollywood Hills High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Florida in 1997 and a law degree from St. Thomas University in 2000.
He is an attorney who says he has 25 years of experience and has spent the past 15 helping people with financial difficulties.
